caption: Fog of war toggled mid-battle with F7: at 1.5 s the far enemy Archers (south-east) vanish while the enemy Infantry inside the player's Cavalry sight disc stays, and a FOG OF WAR indicator appears under the banner; the Cavalry is then ordered to the north-west corner and outruns the Infantry, which drops out of sight and leaves a red ghost outline at its last-seen spot and facing, fading over ten seconds; at 14 s F7 switches fog off and both enemies reappear where they actually are. The simulation is untouched either way (fog only sets CanvasItem.visible).
